home: Create original high-quality Japanese website redesign board for「サンコー自転車商会」in 四日市市. Landscape16:9, desktop left70%, narrow smartphone right25%. Navy, warm white, restrained yellow, technical but friendly bicycle store aesthetic. Original generic unbranded road bicycle photograph, small wheel line icon, no copied logo. Board labels visibly「非公式デザイン案」「写真はイメージです」. Header「サンコー自転車商会」. Hero「自転車のある毎日を、身近に。」smallcaption「四日市市小古曽の自転車店」. Navigation「商品案内」「当店の案内」「新着情報」「お問い合わせ」. Compact content blocks「自転車・パーツ」「点検・調整のご相談」「店舗のご案内」. Improvement explicitly visible: readable wrapped store information and contact cards entirely inside mobile, desktop columns stack vertically on mobile with no clipping. Contact「059-345-0757」「sanko-bc@cty-net.ne.jp」, address「三重県四日市市小古曽1丁目9-16」. Note「お急ぎでないお問い合わせはメールで」「件名をご記入ください」. No free repair claim, no prices, no sales/discounts, no guarantees, no unverified hours, no brand logos, no fictional booking system. Generous readable Japanese text, polished practical layout.
inquiry: Create separate16:9 Japanese inquiry guide page board for サンコー自転車商会, using supplied homepage style reference navy warmwhite yellow bicycle icon. Desktop left70%, narrow mobile right25%. Visible board disclaimer「非公式デザイン案｜写真はイメージです」. Heading「店舗のご案内・お問い合わせ」. Exact correct name「サンコー自転車商会」. Main improvement: store address, phone,email and guidance stack in fullwidth mobile cards, every character visible and wrapped, no sidebar or horizontal clipping. First card「メールでのお問い合わせ」「sanko-bc@cty-net.ne.jp」「お急ぎでないお問い合わせはメールでお願いいたします。」「件名をご記入ください。」「メールを開く」. Secondcard「お電話でのお問い合わせ」「059-345-0757」. Locationcard「三重県四日市市小古曽1丁目9-16」「営業日の作業依頼は事前にご連絡ください。」. Small links「商品案内」「駐車場のご案内」. Existing email/phone only, no form, no instant booking, no prices or inventedhours, no payment claims, no guaranteed repairs. Use small unbranded bicycle closeup imagery. Consistent polished clean layout and readable Japanese with breathing room.
